description: This file defines the 'Manager' class within the 'device' namespace, which provides static methods for initialization, deinitialization, and an indicator for whether the device settings module has been initialized. It is part of the device settings module, specifically related to managing device configurations such as audio, video, and display settings.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: Class to implement the manager interface for device settings, providing static methods for initialization and status checking.
